body.headline: Ship media-rich pages without touching code
body.subheadline: Marketers pick assets from ImageKit's DAM directly inside Storyblok. Developers just render the URL.

features.title: One asset library
features.description: ImageKit stays the single source of truth for media instead of duplicating uploads into Storyblok.

features.title: Real-time transformations
features.description: Resize, crop and optimize at request time by editing the URL — no re-upload needed.

features.title: No backend to run
features.description: The field plugin is hosted by Storyblok; this Next.js app only reads the story's JSON.
